lines.text: Simon Peter tells seven disciples by the Sea of Tiberias he is going fishing, and they catch nothing that night.
Jesus stands on the shore and tells the disciples to cast the net on the left side of the boat.
The disciple whom Jesus loved tells Peter it is the Lord, and Peter puts on his outer garment and jumps into the sea.
On shore the disciples find a charcoal fire, and Peter drags in a net full of 120 large fish.
Jesus gives the disciples bread and fish, and this is the third time He appears to them after being raised.
